false_alarm_worth_recording: The first invoke attempt appeared to fail (aws lambda invoke returned a client-side 'Read timeout' error). This was the AWS CLI's own --cli-read-timeout (set to 60s for this call), not a Lambda failure: CloudWatch Logs for that same invocation showed a clean START/END/REPORT cycle, Duration 107200.77 ms, no exception. A second invoke with a longer CLI read timeout (180s) returned normally. Recorded here because it's exactly the kind of false negative worth being explicit about, having spent real time chasing it before checking the Lambda's own logs.
